items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: I always believed that Paul [Gadden] bought that home after Art sold it you know -- when he died I think his wife just sold it and I think she sold it to Paul. Paul Gidden.

ctx.x: That recording was the solo piano pieces.

That's right. Norman recorded him right at that time. But he was very ill, you know. But when he bought his first home here in View Park, which was quite a thing -- I don't think there were any blacks at all. He came by and got me up and took me up here to see his new home, and I always believed that Paul [Gadden] bought that home after Art sold it you know -- when he died I think his wife just sold it and I think she sold it to Paul. Paul Gidden.
But any way, Art loved piano players, as you know, and we were working together, another time, in New York at Cafe
